Definition: Ezer, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Ezer son of Ephraim is named once, in 1 Chronicles 7:21, and the verse that names him is a sad one. He and his brother Elead went down to take cattle from the men of Gath, and the men of Gath killed them. His father Ephraim mourned for them many days.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Scripture does not hide the losses of God's people. Ezer's name is kept in a genealogy that remembers a raid gone wrong, and I hold that even a short, sorrowful life is worth recording.
